## Channel Selector

Which distribution channels a listing publishes to. Seven check rows from the publish command's own `PUBLISH_CHANNELS` — MLS pinned checked and disabled with a Required tag ("Triggers automatic syndication to major portals"), Zillow/Realtor.com/Redfin tagged Auto-synced, the agent site and socials tagged Optional.

### Contract (render-only)

- `@selected: string[]` — the chosen channel values. The CONSUMER owns this set.
- `@onToggle(channel)` — the consumer adds/removes the channel from its set. MLS never fires it: the row is disabled because Publish Listing unions `'mls'` in regardless — the portals syndicate FROM the MLS entry, so a publish without it is not a publish.
- `...attributes` ride onto the `<ul>` root.

Channel values and labels (`PUBLISH_CHANNELS`, `PUBLISH_CHANNEL_LABELS`) are defined here and imported by Publish Listing — one definition, so the selector can never offer a channel the command doesn't know.

### Accessibility

Each row is a Pret UI `Checkbox` labelled with the channel name: a native checkbox, so keyboard toggling and the disabled MLS row come from the platform, with a `:focus-visible` ring. The row's tag and subline describe its checkbox (`aria-describedby`), so a screen reader hears "Required" or "Optional" with the name.

### Colour

Token-only: the checked box is `--primary`, tags are `--muted-foreground` (the Required tag `--primary-ink`), rows are separated by `--border`. Zero hex literals.

### Non-goals

No persistence (channel preference storage is the consumer's), no publish action, no per-channel status — results render from the command's `channelResults`, not here.
